branding.tagline: Monitor, debug, and optimize generative AI agents with deep insights into interactions, tool usage, LLM performance, and cost footprints.

CONNECTION_NAME.label: Looker Connection Name
CONNECTION_NAME.description: The name of the Looker database connection configured to access the BigQuery dataset containing your agent data.

PROJECT_ID.label: Google Cloud Project ID
PROJECT_ID.description: The Google Cloud Project ID where your BigQuery dataset resides.

DATASET_NAME.label: BigQuery Dataset Name
DATASET_NAME.description: The name of the BigQuery dataset where your agent_events table and ADK views reside (e.g., 'agent_analytic').

TABLE_NAME.label: Base Table Name
TABLE_NAME.description: The name of the base agent events table configured in the ADK (default: agent_events).
